# Agent Federation Network

Purpose: define local contracts for independently administered agent-network federation.

Current scaffold: bounded local peer declaration validation only.

Not implemented: peer authentication, signature verification, remote authorization, credential exchange, network transport, STOP propagation, revocation distribution, remote execution, production interoperability, or certification.

Safety: default deny; explicit scope; short-lived trust; local revocation; emergency STOP blocks use; no implicit trust transitivity. Metadata is not authority.
